# silas

> The agent framework for Rails: durable AI agents as a directory of plain
> files inside an existing Rails app. Exactly-once tool effects (effect +
> ledger in one database transaction), human-in-the-loop approvals that park
> at zero compute, crash-safe turns that resume byte-identical after kill -9,
> replay-safe context compaction, an operator inbox mounted in the host app,
> and deterministic agent evals. Ruby gem; Rails >= 8.1 + Solid Queue.

Quickstart: `rails new desk -m https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/template.rb`
(or `bundle add silas && bin/rails g silas:install` in an existing app).
All docs below are plain markdown and also ship inside the gem package.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/README.md): overview, guarantees, capability grid
- [Tutorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/tutorial.md): build a refund desk, one primitive per chapter
- [Evals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/evals.md): scripted model decisions, real ledger, deploy gates
- [Budgets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/budgets.md): per-turn caps, parking, human top-ups
- [Cancellation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/cancellation.md): cancel semantics mid-flight
- [Connections](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/connections.md): remote MCP servers as YAML files
- [Channels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/channels.md): Slack, email, and generating transports
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/configuration.md): every Silas.configure option with defaults
- [Conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/docs/conventions.md): contracts the UI and API keep
- [Deploy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielstpaul/silas/main/DEPLOY.md): production notes from the chaos harness
